verdict.rationale: No evidence of any account/data export mechanism (e.g., exporting run history, session data, or profiles in open formats) for Browser Use Cloud users; docs only describe running tasks that produce CSV/JSON as task outputs, not exporting the platform's own stored user data. The existence of a separate open-source library (browser-use-docs-19) is a different product path, not a data-export feature of the cloud service.
